motion.note: Motion. Every continuous animation stops off screen, in the background and under a screen reader; each one has its Reduce Motion answer.

tokens.name: press
tokens.usage: The press dip. Unchanged under Reduce Motion.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: A poster rising under the pointer, and settling back. Instant under Reduce Motion.

tokens.name: standard
tokens.usage: State changes, expand, select. Reduce Motion: a 150 ms fade.

tokens.name: emphasized
tokens.usage: The pager, the segmented thumb, the chip rail. Reduce Motion: a 150 ms fade.

tokens.name: enter
tokens.usage: An entrance: rise and fade. Reduce Motion: no rise.

tokens.name: sheet-in
tokens.usage: Sheets and dialogs in. Reduce Motion: a fade.

tokens.name: sheet-out
tokens.usage: Sheets and dialogs out. Reduce Motion: a fade.

tokens.name: shared
tokens.usage: The poster → Media flight. Reduce Motion: a cross-fade.

tokens.name: progress
tokens.usage: A bar moving to a new value. Reduce Motion: a jump.

tokens.name: text-xfade
tokens.usage: Carousel copy changing, rising 10.

tokens.name: image-xfade
tokens.usage: Carousel art changing.

tokens.name: roll
tokens.usage: A figure rolls once from "—" to its value; never counts up from 0. Reduce Motion: the final figure.

tokens.name: light
tokens.usage: The room light moving to a new title. Reduce Motion: a jump.

tokens.name: shimmer
tokens.usage: One skeleton sweep, looping.

tokens.name: dwell
tokens.usage: A carousel slide; the pager fills. Reduce Motion: no auto-advance.

tokens.name: breathe
tokens.usage: One slab's light per screen, alternating on the 12 Hz ambient clock. Reduce Motion: still.

tokens.name: kenburns
tokens.usage: Carousel art drifting 1.02 → 1.12, alternating. Reduce Motion: still.

tokens.name: level-3

tokens.name: hero

tokens.name: float

breakpoint.note: Window regimes, never a device check.

tokens.name: bp-nav-compact
tokens.usage: Below this width the floating bar switches to compact item targets.

tokens.name: bp-desktop-mobile
tokens.usage: Below this width a desktop window paints the touch shell under a bare drag strip.

tokens.name: bp-touch-rail
tokens.usage: At or above this width a touch build moves from the bottom bar to a side rail.

tokens.name: bp-touch-split
tokens.usage: At or above this width a touch build opens a title beside the page it was opened from: the phone's column on the left, the title on the right.

tokens.name: bp-split-list
tokens.usage: The column a page keeps beside an open title on a tablet: the widest phone.

tokens.name: bp-desktop-compact
tokens.usage: Below this width the desktop shell uses its compact variants.

tokens.name: bp-content-well
tokens.usage: The widest the main content well may grow, on any shell.

tokens.name: bp-reading-well
tokens.usage: The widest a page of one column grows: an artist's or an author's page, rows read top to bottom, centred rather than stretched to the window.

tokens.name: bp-desktop-min-width
tokens.usage: Narrowest a desktop window may be dragged: a small phone's width.

tokens.name: bp-desktop-min-height
tokens.usage: Shortest a desktop window may be dragged: the compact artboard's height.
